_comment: Control 4 (PROPOSAL §9.6.1) — reviewer image identity, pinned by DIGEST not tag.
A tag is a mutable pointer; pinning to one is pinning to nothing.
Rotation is an explicit reviewed commit to this file with a reason. That is the point:
drift becomes a diff instead of an accident.
Asserted before every run by scripts/assert_image_digest.py, fail-closed on anything
not listed here. The asserted digest is recorded in the review evidence beside HEAD, so a
finding is bound to the image that produced it.
LIMIT: this binds the image, not its build provenance. It proves 'the same image as last
time', not 'built from trusted inputs'. See §9.6.1.
